title: The Ann Arbor Tenant Bill of Rights
subtitle: A platform for fair, just, and dignified renting in Ann Arbor. By tenants, for tenants.

title: Trash the Junk Fees!
subtitle: A campaign and victory for tenants
lede: What you need to know: Tenants secured a major victory through the passage of an ordinance to limit application fees to $50. More work remains in both legislation and tenant organizing to stop predatory fees by landlords and protect tenants from hidden costs of renting.
